status: draft for the owner's edit (slice (f) lane, 2026-09-06)
artist_scope: none (Tier 3: a static rig; the only motion is a whole-body hit wobble done by the renderer)
character_sheet: A ridden hovercraft the original mod called the Hoverboard: a flat deck that floats over terrain, climbs obstacles, speeds up with the fly key, sometimes shudders into a 45-tick 'exploding' malfunction at speed, shatters into sticks and diamonds when slammed into a wall, and comes in ten paint colours (the Ultimate Sword cycles them). The rig itself never bends: five static cubes.
size_notes: 1.25 x 1.0 block hitbox, drawn at x1; the deck sits at the entity's feet (the descriptor translates the converted rig down 1.5 blocks, ENT-S-091).
formulas: No bone motion: setupAnim is empty (ModelElevator.java:65; orig ModelElevator.java:54-57, `render`, writes no angle). Not a clip: the renderer tilts the whole board on a hit — rotation about X = sin(hitTime) * hitTime * damageTaken / 10 * forwardDirection while timeSinceHit > 0 (RenderElevator.java:31-38 in 1.7.10; ElevatorGeoReplacement.applyRotations:43-58).
Texture variant: elevator<color>.png for colour 1..10 (ElevatorRenderer.java:24-27); elevator.png (no number) is shipped but unreferenced.
behaviour: Static rig. The hit wobble is a renderer rotation of the whole model, driven by the synced timeSinceHit / damageTaken / forwardDirection fields, exactly as vanilla boats.
texture_notes: The ten paint colours are ten separate canvases (elevator1..10); an edit to the board's shape must be made on all ten.
